commands.command: Generate runs/m138_retention_loss_rollout_misalignment_audit/key_loss_rollout_audit.csv and audit_summary.json by comparing M132 and M137 per-row M136 penalties against strict retained keys.
commands.name: m138_retention_loss_rollout_misalignment_audit

decision_rule: Do not design another objective until the mismatch between fixed logprob loss and rollout margin/selected-key retention is measured.
failure_criteria: audit cannot identify which M133 keys are lost
audit only reports aggregate fixed loss
next recipe ignores rollout-level margin gaps
PPO or objective optimization resumes without a rollout-aware guard
hypothesis: M137 shows that improving retained-snippet logprob can reduce strict rollout diversity. The next repair needs a key-level rollout-margin audit before another differentiable objective is chosen.
success_criteria: lost M133 keys are identified for M137 candidates
fixed-loss changes are compared with rollout margin and selected-key changes
a concrete rollout-aware guard or objective direction is selected
no hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced
